COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
WPMS No. 1118 of 2023
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
 Mr. Mehboob Rahi, learned counsel for the
petitioners.
Mr. T.S. Fartiyal, learned Additional C.S.C.
for the State/respondent nos. 1 to 3.
Mr. Ashish Joshi, learned counsel for
respondent no. 4 appearing through video
conferencing.
Petitioners took a loan for dairy business
from Canara Bank, Laksar Branch, District
Haridwar in the year 2020. Since, petitioners
defaulted in repayment of loan, therefore,
respondent-Bank has initiated steps for recovery of
the amount.
In this writ petition, petitioner has challenged
an order passed by District Magistrate, Haridwar,
under Section 14 of the SARFAESI Act. Although,
the said order can be challenged under Section 17
of the said Act before DRT, however, having
regard to the willingness shown by the petitioners
to repay the outstanding dues within 12 months and
the assurance given by learned counsel for the
petitioner that petitioner will deposit a sum or Rs. 3
lakhs with the Bank within four weeks, the writ
petition is disposed of with the following
directions:
i. Petitioner shall submit a representation
seeking reschedulement of the loan along
with upfront deposit of Rs. 3 lakhs within
four weeks before the Competent Authority
in the Bank.
ii. If petitioner makes deposit of Rs. 3 lakhs
within four weeks then respondent-Bank
shall consider petitioner's request for
repayment of the balance amount in six
installments.
iii. For a period of six weeks or till decision on

petitioner's representation, whichever is
earlier, no coercive action shall be taken
against them.
iv. In case petitioners fail to make deposit of Rs.
3 lakhs with the Bank within four weeks,
Competent Authority shall be at liberty to
proceed in the matter, as per law.
Let certified copy of this order be supplied to
the parties today itself on payment of usual
charges.
